scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND "pnpm --filter backend dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter backend test && pnpm --filter frontend test && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: start-server-and-test "concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND \"pnpm --filter backend dev:test\" \"pnpm --filter frontend dev:test\"" "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health/|http://127.0.0.1:4173" "pnpm --filter e2e test"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
